🎙️ MEET OUR TEAM | 2nd CCI–MNLUCS National Antitrust Moot Court Competition, 2026

🎬 RAMYA AGRAWAL | SOCIAL MEDIA HEAD

Some people wait for the spotlight.

She makes sure it shines in the right place.

Meet Ramya Agrawal, Social Media Head for the 2nd CCI–MNLUCS National Antitrust Moot Court Competition, 2026.

Behind every announcement that informs, every creative that captures attention, and every update that keeps our audience engaged is a thoughtful strategy to ensure that the story of this competition reaches far beyond the courtroom.

📌 Role: Social Media Head
 📌 Superpower: Transforming ideas into stories that resonate.
 📌 Mission: Connecting participants, institutions, and the legal community- one post at a time.

Because a competition may begin in the courtroom, but its journey starts with a story. 📱

comment: In legal competitions, communication often shapes participation as much as the event itself. A strong social media strategy is not just visibility—it builds trust, clarity, and a sense of community before the first argument begins.
